Statement storage validates object type, IRIs, score bounds, authenticated actor, duplicate identifiers, and voiding semantics.
xAPI retrieval returns Last-Modified, X-Experience-API-Version, and X-Experience-API-Consistent-Through metadata.
The local HTTP proxy supports OPTIONS, GET, POST, and PUT for statements, CORS, authorization forwarding, and assignment transformation.
The xAPI store implements statement and voided-statement identifiers, agent, verb, activity, related-agent, related-activity, since, until, ordering, limit, and exact, canonical, or ids formats.
Launch URLs emit endpoint, activity_id, Basic auth, serialized actor, and native-only xapiIpcPackage parameters.
The xAPI store assigns missing identifiers, validates object type, IRIs, extension IRIs, score bounds, actor authorization, duplicates, and voiding.
HTTP semantics define representation metadata, conditional requests, and response status behavior used by the RESPECT validator.
HTTP caching semantics define cache validators and successful 304 revalidation used by the RESPECT validator.
